title: Hancock–Dibble debate and the shipwreck data
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Hancock–Dibble debate and the shipwreck data, about 2024 at an unknown place, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: you can see Graham Hancock debate flint dible and then you can fact checked Flint Dibble and realized that he got all his shipwreck data completely wrong

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about a 2024 debate between Graham Hancock, a writer who argues for a lost ancient civilisation, and Flint Dibble, an archaeologist who disagrees with him. Michels says that if you fact-check Dibble afterwards, you find he got his figures about ancient shipwrecks completely wrong. He tells it to suggest that the experts' case against Hancock is weaker than it looked on stage.
